tha-ap161:1.1: Punnāgapupphiya.] Kānanaṃ vanam ogayha vasāmi luddako ahaṃ / punnāgaṃ pupphitaṃ disvā Buddhaseṭṭhaṃ anussariṃ. // //
tha-ap161:2.1: Taṃ pupphaṃ ocinitvāna sugandhaṃ gandhagandhitaṃ / thūpaṃ karitvā puḷine Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ. // //
tha-ap161:3.1: Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap161:4.1: Ekamhi navute kappe eko āsi Tamonudo / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap161:6.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Punnāgapupphiyo thero i. g. ā-ti. Punnāgapupphiyattherassa
